verdict.rationale: Persona is API/webhook-driven with sandbox mode, simulate actions for programmatic testing, and pre-creation of inquiries via API, all of which support headless/CI-style automation of identity verification workflows. However, there is no explicit CLI, no documented CI/CD integration examples, and no first-class 'headless mode' framing — missing for 10: dedicated CLI or CI-pipeline documentation, explicit headless-mode guidance, and independent/hands-on evidence of running Persona in an automated pipeline.
